objective: Qualified trial downloads and attributable purchases from original TikTok content modeled on observed successful formats.

research.cadence: Each production cycle: scout 10-20 candidates, watch 5, shortlist 3, model 1. Recheck metrics before production. No schedule installed.
research.breakoutHeuristic: Organic post with at least 10,000 views and at least 3 times the median views of 5 comparable recent posts from its creator; hypothesis for prioritization, not a promise of virality.
modeling: Capture source URL, creator, upload date, region, observed metrics and observation time.
Separate paid ads, organic posts and editorial examples.
Watch the opening, annotate beats and payoff, and record the viewer motivation.
Preserve the attention mechanism; change the situation, script, visual execution and payoff to a Lemonade-specific demonstration.
Check that the twist naturally serves a buyer problem before scripting.
Use an original-test label when current breakout evidence is unavailable.

publishing.music: Original licensed audio or Commercial Music Library
publishing.approval: Review rendered video, claims, voice, captions and destination before publishing.

experiment.cadence: Evaluate reviewed Lemonade product slots within the creator calendar; the three prepared scripts are alternatives, not three consecutive launch posts.
experiment.success: Compare qualified visits, trials and purchases alongside retention. Do not select winners on views alone.

role: First product campaign on Alex creator account; not the account identity or full editorial calendar.
